images.concept: IMPACTFUL HERO COMPOSITION. Cinematic editorial portrait on deep black #050505 background. Left side (50% of frame): a person seated at a dark matte desk, 3/4 left angle, body from mid-torso up visible, calm confident direct gaze into camera, right hand gently extended toward the mascot beside them. Right side of the desk: a 3D VOXEL PIXEL-ART CHARACTER MASCOT in warm terracotta orange (#D97856) — same blocky Minecraft-like cubic body with two rectangular dot eyes, short cubic arms raised in a friendly wave pose, matte clay finish with subtle 3D shading. The mascot stands on the desk at chest-height next to the person. Behind the mascot: a LARGE GLOWING TERRACOTTA ASTERISK / STARBURST SYMBOL floating in mid-air (the Claude symbol) — bright terracotta color with a soft halo bloom, rendered as a sharp 3D sculptural object about 30-35% of frame width, suggesting authority and identity. Radial terracotta-amber glow behind the mascot and symbol fades to deep black at the frame edges. Warm directional rim light from camera-left wraps the person's jaw/shoulder in gold-terracotta. Clear negative space in top 35% and extreme left 5% for headline overlay. Subtle film grain, cinematic dark luxury finish, editorial boutique. NO TEXT in image. 4:5 vertical composition.
